messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Find all event triggers of the event types below in the document.

Event types:
- Attack: An agent physically assaults or launches a violent attack on a target (bombing, ambush, raid, shooting, assault). (e.g. attack, assaulted, ambushed, bombing)
- Military_operation: Organised armed conflict between forces: a war, battle, campaign, siege or military operation as a whole. (e.g. war, battle, fought, campaign)
- Conquering: An agent takes control of a place or group by force (capture, seize, conquer, occupy). (e.g. captured, conquer, seized, taken)
- Killing: A killer causes the death of a victim (an agent is responsible for the death). (e.g. killed, killing, murdered, massacre)
- Death: Someone dies, with focus on the death itself rather than on a killer. (e.g. died, death, dead, deaths)
- Bodily_harm: Someone is physically injured or wounded. (e.g. injured, wounded, injuries, hurt)
- Catastrophe: A natural or man-made disaster happens (storm, flood, earthquake, crash, fire, accident). (e.g. hurricane, storm, flood, earthquake)
- Destroying: Something is destroyed completely (destroyed, demolished, sunk, burned down). (e.g. destroyed, destruction, demolished, sank)
- Damaging: Something is damaged but not completely destroyed. (e.g. damage, damaged, struck, battered)
- Statement: A speaker communicates a message (says, states, announces, describes, reports). (e.g. said, stated, announced, described)
- Change_of_leadership: Leadership or control of a polity or organisation changes (election, coup, revolution, ousting, independence, replacement of a leader). (e.g. elected, coup, revolution, ousted)
- Arriving: An agent arrives at or reaches a place. (e.g. arrived, reached, entered, landed)

Trigger annotation rules:
- A trigger is the single word (sometimes a short phrase) that most clearly expresses the event; it can be a verb ("attacked") or a noun ("attack", "war", "fires").
- Annotate EVERY occurrence: if the same event is mentioned several times ("the fires ... the fires ..."), list each occurrence as a separate entry.
- Only annotate the 12 event types below; ignore other kinds of events.
- Disambiguation:
  * Military_operation = a war, battle, campaign or siege as a whole; Attack = one specific assault, bombing, raid, shelling or ambush.
  * Conquering = capturing or taking control of a place or group (captured, seized, took, defeated and occupied).
  * Killing = someone or something kills (killed, massacre, slain, executed); Death = the dying itself (died, death, dead, fatalities).
  * Catastrophe = the disaster event itself (storm, hurricane, fire, flood, crash, accident); Destroying = something is completely destroyed; Damaging = something is damaged but not destroyed.
  * Bodily_harm = injury or wounding (injured, wounded, injuries).

Return JSON: {"triggers": [{"trigger": "<word copied from the document>", "type": "<event type>"}]}
List one entry per occurrence, in reading order. Return {"triggers": []} if there is none.

### Example 1
Document:
SummerSlam (2013) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE that took place on August 18, 2013 at Staples Center in Los Angeles, California. It was the twenty-sixth annual SummerSlam, and the fifth consecutive one held at Staples Center. The event's card consisted of nine matches, including the pre-show. In the main event, Daniel Bryan defeated John Cena to become the new WWE Champion, with Triple H acting as special guest referee, only to be attacked by Triple H and lose it minutes later to Randy Orton, who cashed in the Money in the Bank contract. Elsewhere on the event's card, Alberto Del Rio defeated Christian to retain the World Heavyweight Championship and Brock Lesnar defeated CM Punk in a No Disqualification match. The event received 296,909 buys, down from last year's event of 358,000.
Output:
{"triggers": [{"trigger": "defeated", "type": "Conquering"}, {"trigger": "attacked", "type": "Attack"}, {"trigger": "defeated", "type": "Conquering"}, {"trigger": "defeated", "type": "Conquering"}]}

### Example 2
Document:
Elimination Chamber (2013) (also known as No Escape (2013) in Germany) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on February 17, 2013, at the New Orleans Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. The pay-per-view was the fourth annual Elimination Chamber event. Eight matches, including the headlined pre-show, were contested at the event. In the Elimination Chamber match main event to decide the # 1 contender for the World Heavyweight Championship, Jack Swagger defeated Chris Jericho, Randy Orton, Daniel Bryan, Kane and Mark Henry, including Kaitlyn retaining the WWE Divas ' Championship against Tamina Snuka and The Rock retaining the WWE Championship against CM Punk. The event received 213,000 pay-per-view buys, up from 178,000 buys the previous year's event received.
Output:
{"triggers": [{"trigger": "defeated", "type": "Conquering"}]}

### Example 3

over the limit (2011) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (ppv) event produced by wwe. It took place on May 22, 2011 at the KeyArena in Seattle, Washington. it was the second over the limit event. Nine matches took place during the event of which were broadcast live on pay-per-view. In the main event, John Cena retained the WWE Championship by defeating The Miz in an " I Quit " match. Elsewhere on the card, Wade Barrett retained his Intercontinental Championship by Ezekiel Jackson, Big Show and Kane retained the WWE Tag Team Championship against The New Nexus, Brie Bella retained the Divas ' Championship against Kelly Kelly and Randy Orton retained the World Heavyweight Championship against Christian. over the limit received 140,000 buys worldwide, significantly down from the 2010 edition's 197,000 buys.

### Now the target
Document:
Survivor Series (2011) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on November 20, 2011 at Madison Square Garden in New York City. It was the 25th annual Survivor Series event and the first one to take place in Madison Square Garden since the 2002 event. Tickets were sold out in only 90 minutes. Seven matches were contested at the event, six of which were broadcast live on pay-per-view. The main events from this installment of Survivor Series would have a lasting effect on the next year in the WWE. In the main event, The Rock, in his first match since WrestleMania XX in 2004, teamed with John Cena and defeated The Miz and R-Truth. A predominant match saw Big Show defeat World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry by disqualification. In another predominant match on the card, CM Punk was victorious over Alberto Del Rio by submission to win the WWE Championship, a reign that would continue until January 27, 2013 and become the sixth longest in the company's history. The event garnered 281,000 pay-per-view buys, up from 244,000 buys the previous year's event.
